messages:
maria: Post-canary alert - migration job for inference-worker v3.4.0 failed in ap-south-1. Deploy-bot marked the canary degraded. ServiceAccount mismatch in the job pod. Do we pin this chart or roll back?

deploy-bot: canary health = degraded (12m)
reason: Job inference-migration-16823 failed -> pod error: serviceaccount "inference-migration-sa" not found
logs: 
```
Error from server: serviceaccount "inference-migration-sa" not found
Job controller: Back-off restarting failed container
```

kai: Any idea which SA the chart expects vs what actually exists in the cluster? :eyes:

maria: Chart values reference migration.serviceAccount.name = inference-migration-sa but our cluster only has inference-sa (created by infra long ago). Looks like a values drift during chart bump.

anya: Two options: 1) create the missing SA + rolebindings quickly and re-run the migration job; 2) patch the release to reuse inference-sa via a values override. I lean toward creating the SA so migration-specific RBAC stays scoped.

kai: +1 for creating the SA (sa scoped > reusing global). How urgent is this for production traffic?

maria: Canary is degraded but user-facing inference API is unaffected (traffic routed to stable), so we can do a controlled fix.

anya: Proposed quick patch (apply SA and minimal RBAC):
```
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: inference-migration-sa
  namespace: inference
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: inference-migration-sa-binding
  namespace: inference
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: migration-runner
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: inference-migration-sa
  namespace: inference
EOF
```

kai: After creating SA we should re-run the helm migration hook or run the job manually. Prefer manual to avoid Helm lifecycle edgecases.

maria: Plan: pin the release (prevent autopromotion), apply SA patch, manually trigger the migration job, verify logs, then un-pin+promote if healthy. I'll assemble release notes for the change window.

sre-ops: For the pin: add annotation `redwood/deploy-pin: "true"` on the release resource and post a short note in release tracking. Also need a quick rollback plan if job mutates DB unexpectedly.

maria: Noted. Rollback plan: revert to v3.3.9 chart and restore DB snapshot from pre-migration backup (backup run at 2026-03-21T02:00Z). I have the snapshot id.

deploy-bot: Action: pinned release inference-worker v3.4.0 (reason: post-canary migration job failure) - promotion blocked until manual unpin.

anya: I created the SA + RB binding in inference/ap-south-1 and kicked off a manual migration job: `kubectl create job --from=job/inference-migration inference-migration-manual-4801239999 -n inference`

deploy-bot: Manual job started -> pod initializing.

(10m later)
deploy-bot: Manual migration job completed; pod logs show success and no RBAC errors. Canary health regained. canary health = passing (12m).

maria: Good. I'll update release notes: mention SA creation, pin during fix, manual re-run, and the DB rollback plan (if needed). We'll unpin and promote in next change window (tomorrow 10:00 UTC) after ops + PM signoff. :shipit:

sre-ops: Please add the RBAC manifest and the release-note blurb to the release PR for audit. I'll attach the backup id as well.

maria: Will do. Thanks all.
